subject: Error in dcast when using no variable for rows

messages.author: 92a46c9449c605e2
messages.subject: Error in dcast when using no variable for rows
parts:
Hello,

In reshape2 (v1.2.2), I get an error when flipping the casting formula from "variable ~ ." to ". ~ variable.  Any ideas why this may be the case?

> dcast(airquality, Month ~ ., value.var="Solar.R", sum)
  Month   NA
1     5   NA
2     6 5705
3     7 6711
4     8   NA
5     9 5023

> dcast(airquality, . ~ Month, value.var="Solar.R", sum)

Error: nrow(res$labels[[1]]) == nrow(data) is not TRUE

Thanks
